channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Flights at Burlington International Airport are mostly back to normal, but delays continue. Airport officials praised teamwork among staff and local businesses. Some travelers faced long delays and had to find alternate ways to reach Vermont.

About seventy Vermont Air National Guard members returned from Germany after nearly a year. They were deployed to train Ukrainian soldiers in combatting Russian aggression. More soldiers are expected to return Sunday, completing the deployment.

Vermont's rifle deer season opened at sunrise on November fourteenth and runs through November twenty-ninth. Hunters can take one legal buck and must report it within forty-eight hours. The season supports deer population management and ecosystem health.

Senator Peter Welch introduced a bill to support Iran war veterans exposed to toxic substances. The legislation aims to ease access to health benefits for affected service members. Welch also backs a bill to track and reduce risks from military burn pits.
